# RefList

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

An `include` and an `exclude` list. An empty `include` means every
entry; a match in `exclude` always wins.

Appears at: `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/principals`, `/policy/scope/principals`, `/policy/unknown/scope_groups/all_of/principals`, `/policy/unknown/scopes/principals`, `/rule_sets/rules/scope/principals`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `exclude` | array of [`PrincipalRef`](principal-ref.md) | no |  | at most 1000 items | 1.0.0 | Never matches when any entry matches, whatever `include` says. |
| `include` | array of [`PrincipalRef`](principal-ref.md) | no |  | at most 1000 items | 1.0.0 | Matches when any entry matches. Empty means everyone or everything. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
